newsitem.title: USA: American Air implements cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: American Air implements cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: American Airlines said it will implement a cargo surcharge of 10 cents per kilo on much of its global network, effective on November 15, to offset sharply higher fuel costs.
The surcharge will apply on all routes from the U.S. to Europe, Latin America, the Caribbean and Mexico.
A similar $0.10/kilo surcharge will apply from Europe to the U.S., Canada, Latin America, Mexico and the Caribbean, the carrier said.

A C$0.12 cent/kilo surcharge will be applied as of November 25 on routes from Canada to Europe, Mexico and Latin America, while a surcharge of C$0.05/kilo will apply on routes from Canada to the U.S., also from November 25.
The company did not indicate any intention to add a surcharge on transpacific routes.
